text: Assumption: The assignment of diagnostic clients to concrete instances of ClientAuthentication takes place at runtime based on the configured source address ranges — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The assignment of diagnostic clients to concrete instances of ClientAuthentication takes place at runtime based on the configured source address ranges — is this correct?
norm: the assignment of diagnostic clients to concrete instances of clientauthentication takes place at runtime based on the configured source address ranges
assumption: The assignment of diagnostic clients to concrete instances of ClientAuthentication takes place at runtime based on the configured source address ranges.
rationale: The model element DiagnosticExternalAuthenticationIdentification allows address ranges when the final address is not known at compile time (SWS Diagnostics, p. 129).

original.text: Annahme: Die Zuordnung von Diagnose-Clients zu konkreten Instanzen von ClientAuthentication erfolgt zur Laufzeit anhand der konfigurierten Quelladressbereiche — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Die Zuordnung von Diagnose-Clients zu konkreten Instanzen von ClientAuthentication erfolgt zur Laufzeit anhand der konfigurierten Quelladressbereiche.
original.rationale: Das Modellelement DiagnosticExternalAuthenticationIdentification erlaubt Adressbereiche, wenn die finale Adresse zur Compile-Zeit nicht bekannt ist (SWS Diagnostics, S. 129).
